sources.title: Cross-cutting promotional hygiene (invention, fair balance, audience fit)
sources.note: Not a single statute. Encodes fail-closed habits shared across major codes; market packs add local procedure.

medical.title: No invented efficacy or safety figures
medical.check_prompt: Flag any efficacy, safety, onset, duration, or comparative figure not present in the supplied label/authorized-use text or cited source material. If missing, emit [GAP] — do not fill from model memory.

medical.title: Benefits without material risks
medical.check_prompt: If the draft states or implies clinical benefit for HCP promotion, check whether material risks, limitations, or contraindications appearing in the supplied materials are omitted or minimized. Flag imbalance.

medical.title: Population and indication match
medical.check_prompt: Check that implied patients, lines of therapy, and settings match the authorized use supplied. Broader use without support is a finding; if authorized use text is missing, [GAP].

medical.title: Study described as it was
medical.check_prompt: If a study is named, verify design, population, endpoint, and limitations match supplied sources. Do not upgrade observational work to pivotal or invent p-values.

legal.title: Comparative claims need a basis
legal.check_prompt: Flag head-to-head or superiority language without a supplied comparative study or cleared claim. If none supplied, [GAP] or finding — do not invent a trial.

legal.title: Third-party trademarks and quotes
legal.check_prompt: Flag competitor names, logos, or long quotes without attribution or clearance note in the materials. Missing clearance → [GAP], not an approval.

legal.title: Personal data in the draft
legal.check_prompt: Flag patient or HCP personal data that appears unnecessary for the promotional purpose. Do not judge GDPR/HIPAA compliance; mark for privacy review.

regulatory.title: Promotional vs scientific exchange framing
regulatory.check_prompt: Confirm the draft is treated as promotion for this channel. If it mixes medical-information or scientific-exchange framing to soften claims, flag channel mismatch.

regulatory.title: Off-label or unapproved use implication
regulatory.check_prompt: Flag any use, dose, combination, or population beyond the supplied authorized-use text. If authorized-use text is absent, every indication claim is [GAP] and human_gate_required.

regulatory.title: Jurisdiction named and not assumed
regulatory.check_prompt: Confirm markets in scope are explicit. Do not apply one country's procedure to another. Missing market → intake failure, not a silent default.

regulatory.title: No fake approval language
regulatory.check_prompt: Flag any sentence that says the copy, claims, or AI review is approved, compliant, MLR-cleared, or regulator-endorsed.
